name: Ratatouille Masala
description: A Provençal aubergine, courgette and pepper stew built on a South Asian temper of cumin, mustard seeds and turmeric. Vegetarian, halal, and deeply flavoured.
keywords: ratatouille masala, spiced ratatouille, indian french vegetable stew, masala ratatouille recipe, vegetarian fusion, halal ratatouille
recipeIngredient: 350 g (12 oz) aubergine, cut into 2 cm cubes
400 g (14 oz) courgettes, cut into 2 cm half-moons
1 red bell pepper (200 g / 7 oz), cut into 2 cm pieces
1 yellow bell pepper (200 g / 7 oz), cut into 2 cm pieces
400 g (14 oz) ripe tomatoes, roughly chopped, or one 400 g tin whole plum tomatoes, crushed
1 medium onion (180 g / 6 oz), finely sliced
½ tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
1 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste
½ tsp black pepper, freshly ground

recipeInstructions.name: Salt the aubergine
recipeInstructions.text: Toss the aubergine cubes with a generous pinch of salt and leave in a colander for 15 minutes. Pat dry with kitchen paper.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the aubergine
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide heavy pan over medium-high heat. Fry aubergine in batches until golden brown on at least two sides, 6 to 8 minutes. Remove to a plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the courgettes
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan. Add courgettes and cook over medium-high heat without stirring for 2 minutes, then cook until lightly golden, about 5 minutes total. Remove to the plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the peppers
recipeInstructions.text: Add a splash more oil if needed. Add the red and yellow peppers and cook over medium heat until softened and lightly coloured at the edges, about 6 minutes. Remove to the plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the temper
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium-low. Add remaining olive oil. Once shimmering, add cumin seeds and mustard seeds. When they pop (30 to 45 seconds), add the sliced onion.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the onion
recipeInstructions.text: Cook onion over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until deep golden and beginning to caramelise, about 12 minutes. Add garlic and cook 2 more minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the ground spices
recipeInstructions.text: Add turmeric, ground coriander and Kashmiri chilli powder. Stir for 30 seconds over low heat. Add a splash of water if the pan looks dry.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the tomatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Add chopped fresh or crushed tinned tomatoes. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes collapse and oil separates at the edges, about 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine everything
recipeInstructions.text: Return cooked aubergine, courgettes and peppers to the pan. Stir gently to coat. Season with salt and black pepper. Cover partially and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Add red wine vinegar, stir once, and taste for seasoning. Scatter fresh coriander and torn basil over the top just before serving.
